newsitem.title: USA: USDA offers Fla. producers emergency assistance.
newsitem.headline: USDA offers Fla. producers emergency assistance.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department Friday said producers in 28 Florida counties would be eligible for low interest emergency loans.

"In order to help family-sized farm operations in Florida that were hit by the devastating freeze in January, Secretary Glickman on behalf of the Clinton Administration has granted secretary disaster declaration to 28 Florida counties," Deputy Agriculture Secretary Richard Rominger told USDA Radio.
Rominger said Glickman notified Florida's governor of the decision in a letter late Thursday.
Earlier this month, USDA said it would buy Florida orange juice to help ease the economic burden caused by the winter freeze.
Rominger said farmers in these counties should visit their local Farm Service Agency offices for information on the emergency loans.
